svg.title: One-hot codes give each word its own column with a single 1; four made-up features describe the same words with fewer, fuller columns
svg.desc: Left: an eleven by eleven grid, one row per content word of the blurbs, with a 1 on the diagonal and 0 elsewhere. Right: the same eleven words described by four hand-set features, crime, place, food and tools, shaded by value.

g.text: 11 columns, a single 1 in each row
columns in the same order as the rows
how much of each quality a word has
one-hot: 110 of 121 cells are 0 and no two rows share a 1; features: 17 of 44 cells are 0
the feature values are invented for this book; a learned embedding picks its own columns
